source.title: Proofs to Some Open Problems on the Maximum Sombor Index of Graphs

trace.notes: Input normalized as a zbMATH resolver URL with document identifier 7735395. Local resolver metadata in outputs/open-problems-0418-all.csv identifies the exact work as 'Proofs to some open problems on the maximum Sombor index of graphs' and gives DOI 10.1007/s40314-023-02423-6.

Direct local curl access to zbmath.org, api.zbmath.org, and oai.zbmath.org failed with DNS resolution errors in the sandbox. Browser/search recovery located the DOI landing page, a Universiti Brunei Darussalam publication page, a ResearchGate record, and a DBLP resolver record for the same exact title.

The Springer DOI landing page at https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s40314-023-02423-6 exposes only the title, authors, abstract, references, and access controls, and states that the page is a preview of subscription content with article PDF purchase access. This is not readable full text for extraction.

The Universiti Brunei Darussalam page for the exact title exposes only publication metadata and an abstract. The ResearchGate exact-title record states that no full text is available. Exact-title and DOI searches did not recover an exact-work PDF, author manuscript, repository copy, or full HTML source.

Failure mode classified as paywalled_or_restricted plus metadata_only candidates. The contract forbids extracting questions from abstracts, citation metadata, resolver records, or snippets when no readable full-text technical source is recovered, so accepted remains empty and the item is moved to needs_review as error_input.
Saved exact JSON result to outputs/parse-paper/zbmath_7735395.json and outputs/latest.json.
